title: achillea millefolium var. lanulosa
intro: Achillea millefolium var. lanulosa, commonly known as Yarrow, is a perennial plant in the Asteraceae family. It has been used for centuries to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Yarrow include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic, making it effective in treating wounds, colds, and flu. The bioactive constituents of Yarrow include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
